search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，$D:y\geq x,x\geq-1,y\leq1$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $\int_{-1}^1dy\int_y^1f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-1}^1dx\int_{-1}^xf(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-1}^1dx\int_x^1f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-1}^0dy\int_{-1}^yf(x,y)dx$ 解答 原式$=\int_{-1}^{1}dx\int_x^1f(x,y)dy$，原式$=\int_{-1}^{1}dy\int_{-1}^{y}f(x,y)dx$。
